ANDROID

Android app

Version 1.0.3 · 94 KB APK · Android 7.0 or later
Download APK Use in browser
Install or update the APK
  1. Download the APK and open it from your Downloads folder.
  2. If Android asks, allow your browser to install this app, then tap Install or Update.
  3. Open VOIDLINE from its app icon. A compatible browser and an internet connection are required.

If the app closes, choose Use in browser above to open your chats. Sign in with the same VOIDLINE account if prompted.

WINDOWS PC

Windows app

A portable desktop app. Extract the ZIP before opening it.

Version 1.0.0 · 158 MB ZIP · Windows 10 or later · 64-bit
Download for Windows

Extract all files, then open VOIDLINE from the extracted folder. This app build is not code-signed.

Live chats need internet. App files contain the client, never your account data. Updates to the live interface appear when you reopen the app.

iPhone, iPad & Mac

Use the browser installation below. A native iPhone app file still needs Apple signing before distribution.

Open VOIDLINE in browser

Your browser may offer its own install prompt. Otherwise, the device steps below stay available.

You’re using VOIDLINE in app mode.

Browser installation steps
iPhone & iPadAndroid browserPC & Mac browser

Install on your device

Open VOIDLINE in the browser listed for your device. If you arrived inside a social or messaging app, open this link in your browser first.

01 / iOS

iPhone & iPad

  1. Open the VOIDLINE app in Safari.
  2. Use Share, then Add to Home Screen. If needed, find Share inside the browser’s More menu.
  3. Keep Open as Web App enabled when shown, then confirm with Add.

Open the new VOIDLINE icon to sign in.

02 / ANDROID

Android

  1. Open the VOIDLINE app in Chrome.
  2. In the browser menu, look for Install app, Add to Home screen or Install and create shortcut.
  3. Choose the installation option and confirm the browser’s instructions.

The exact menu label depends on your browser version.

03 / DESKTOP

PC & Mac

  1. Open the VOIDLINE app in Chrome or Microsoft Edge.
  2. Choose the install icon in the address bar when shown. In Chrome’s menu, try Cast, save and share → Install page as app. In Edge, try More tools → Apps → Install this site as an app.
  3. Confirm, then open VOIDLINE from your app launcher, Start menu or desktop shortcut.

On a Mac using Safari, use File → Add to Dock when available.

Live chats need an internet connection. Browser installation keeps the same web app and its automatic updates. You can also keep using VOIDLINE in a normal tab.
